headline: More than 400 family polyclinics in Samarkand region to be modernized with World Bank assistance
summary: The World Bank is supporting the upgrade of more than 400 family polyclinics in Samarkand region and training over 6,400 medical workers. The government allocates $425 million to the programme, and the World Bank provides a $100 million concessional loan.
why: World Bank financing of public programmes is a major source of concessional funding for developing economies, shaping public spending and infrastructure investment.
original_headline: Samarqand viloyatida 400 dan ortiq oilaviy poliklinika Jahon banki ko‘magida modernizatsiya qilinadi
